changeSet.author: Thomas Klok
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[IntersectTypeDetail] as SELECT IT.uid, IT.ID, SATT.Uid as SubjectUid, SATT.ID as SubjectAssetTypeID, IT.Subject, IT.SubjectID, IT.SubjectCardinality, CASE IT.Subject WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(SIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (SATT.Name, SDT.Name) END AS SubjectName, COALESCE (SIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS SubjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS SubjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (SATT.Name, SDT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS SubjectIconText, SP.Path as SubjectAssetTypePath, OATT.Uid as ObjectUid, OATT.ID as ObjectAssetTypeID, IT.Object, IT.ObjectID, IT.ObjectCardinality, CASE IT.Object WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(OIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (OATT.Name, ODT.Name) END AS ObjectName, COALESCE (OIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS ObjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS ObjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (OATT.Name, ODT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS ObjectIconText, OP.Path as ObjectAssetTypePath, IT.PredicateID, P.Name AS PredicateName, P.Inverse AS PredicateInverse, P.Type AS PredicateType, COALESCE (IT.IsSystem, CAST(0 AS bit)) AS IsSystem FROM dbo.IntersectType AS IT WITH (nolock) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Predicate AS P WITH (nolock) ON P.ID = IT.PredicateID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS SATT WITH (nolock) ON SATT.Object = IT.Subject AND SATT.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS SDT ON IT.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.SubjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS SIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Subject = 'IntersectType' AND SIT.ID = IT.SubjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS OATT WITH (nolock) ON OATT.Object = IT.Object AND OATT.ObjectID = IT.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS OIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Object = 'IntersectType' AND OIT.ID = IT.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 0 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS ODT ON IT.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.ObjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetTypeStyle SIcon WITH (nolock) ON SIcon.ID = SATT.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetTypeStyle OIcon WITH (nolock) on OIcon.ID = OATT.ID CROSS APPLY dbo.GetAssetTypeTextPathById(OATT.ID, ' / ') OP CROSS APPLY dbo.GetAssetTypeTextPathById(SATT.ID, ' / ') SP WHERE (COALESCE (SATT.ID, SDT.ID, SIT.ID) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE (OATT.ID, ODT.ID, OIT.ID) IS NOT NULL)
